answer: Plant a juniper seedling for each newcomer in a meadow grove tended by five unrelated members, each holding one fragment of the activation key. The seedling grows only if a different guardian tends it each week for six weeks, watering it and asking a fresh question about the newcomer's claimed work; a guardian tending two seedlings in one grove loses their stake. Activation needs all five fragments, so a Sybil farmer must control five trusted members per fake account and keep each juniper alive for six weeks, while a real person simply joins one grove and lets neighbours take turns.
